title: Database Decision Cheat Sheet — Failure Injection & Auto-Healing
purpose: Simulates Database Failover & Replication Resiliency: Cloud SQL High Availability zonal failover vs Cloud Spanner Multi-Region Paxos consensus during datacenter failure.
routing_rationale: Comparing failover mechanisms highlights the difference between Cloud SQL's 60-second active-standby restart versus Cloud Spanner's continuous sub-second Paxos quorum.

nodes.label: Cloud SQL Primary (Dead)
nodes.detail: Hardware failure in zone us-central1-a terminates primary database instance.

nodes.label: Cloud SQL HA Watchdog
nodes.detail: Detects 30 seconds of missed heartbeats; initiates automated regional disk failover.

nodes.label: Promoted Standby Cloud SQL
nodes.product: Promoted to Primary in Zone B
nodes.detail: Attaches regional persistent disk and recovers crash logs in 52 seconds.

nodes.label: GKE App Pods Reconnected
nodes.detail: Cloud SQL Proxy seamlessly updates connection IP; application resumes transactions.

steps.title: Automated Zonal Failover
steps.action: Watchdog detects failure and promotes standby instance on regional persistent disk.
steps.why_traversal: Provides automated disaster recovery without data loss within the region.

steps.title: Application Recovery
steps.action: Cloud SQL Proxy transparently redirects client queries to the new primary in Zone B in under 60s.
steps.why_traversal: Restores production database availability with zero manual intervention.

scenarios.label: Application Crashes Due to Stale Connection Pool
scenarios.root_cause: Application connection pool was configured without validation query or max-lifetime.
scenarios.diverted_path: Pods held dead TCP connections to dead Zone A; threw continuous 500 errors.
scenarios.blast_radius: Outage persisted for 30 minutes until pods were manually restarted.
scenarios.recovery: Configure HikariCP / DB pool with testOnBorrow=true and maxLifetime=1800000ms.

scenarios.label: Quota exhausted
scenarios.root_cause: A project or regional quota reaches its allocation limit.
scenarios.diverted_path: Requests surface elevated latency, errors, or denied actions.
scenarios.blast_radius: Consumers of the affected resource or dependency.
scenarios.recovery: Reduce load, restore the dependency, and add a tested prevention.

scenarios.label: Dependency unavailable
scenarios.root_cause: A required API or downstream dependency is unavailable.
scenarios.diverted_path: Requests surface elevated latency, errors, or denied actions.
scenarios.blast_radius: Consumers of the affected resource or dependency.
scenarios.recovery: Reduce load, restore the dependency, and add a tested prevention.
